notes.title: Updated Environment
notes.content: The environment has been updated, as well as the ability to slide connected pieces around and play custom radio stations.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
The environment has now been changed to a garden and the game title has been updated to reflect this.

The game is now a seated experience only.

The magnetic effect while handling jigsaw pieces has now been removed and the piece will only snap into place once you release the trigger.

Support for the Valve Index Controllers has been added.

notes.title: Added table option.
notes.content: An option to use a table, instead of doing the puzzle on the floor, has been added. Using the table, you can either do the puzzle standing or seated on a chair situated in the center of your play space.
